title: The Little Adventure of Nila and Kavi

pages.text: As the sun began to set, painting the sky in shades of orange and pink, Nila and Kavi said goodbye to their magical friends. "Come back soon!" the trees and flowers called out. The two friends walked home hand in hand, their hearts full of joy and wonder.

That night, as Nila and Kavi lay in their beds, they smiled thinking about their amazing adventure. They learned that the world is full of magic and wonder, if only you have the courage to explore it. And they knew that together, they could face any adventure that awaited them. The End.
